_comment: Mutation testing measures whether the suite actually kills injected faults, not just whether lines run. Scoped to the correctness and security core; the lexer, parser, async evaluator, stdlib, checker, and autocomplete are separate future scope expansions. The final 20 August 2026 v1 run scored 88.07% overall and 90.91% on covered mutants across 1,852 scored mutants (1,627 killed, 4 timed out, 163 survived, 58 uncovered, 0 errors). The source documents 27 excluded host-feature/performance-scheduling mutants that cannot change results; even counting no timeouts as kills, the score is 87.85%. The 87% break threshold is a regression floor and must be ratcheted up, never down. Remaining survivors include equivalent switch/fall-through and defensive-branch mutants as well as visible future test-hardening work; the HTML artifact is the source of truth.
